projects.name: MyoPack | Wearable EMG Biofeedback System for Injury Recovery
projects.role: Lead Software Engineer | Senior Capstone Project

bullets.text: Built a wearable 4-channel EMG biofeedback system on an ESP32 with dual 24-bit ADS1292 analog front ends, developing embedded C++ firmware and a real-time DSP pipeline (Butterworth bandpass, 60Hz notch filter, RMS envelope, normalization) to validate live signal integrity at 20Hz.

Tested and validated embedded firmware across 50+ field sessions spanning users of varying fitness levels, root-causing signal stability issues and iterating on hardware/firmware fixes to ensure consistent, production-quality sensor output.
